rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Ой! Смотрите, луна!
rows.text: Oh! Look, the moon!
rows.heard: I will look the moon.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вчера от неё был тоненький кусочек. А сегодня она снова целая!
rows.text: Yesterday it was just a thin little piece. And today it's whole again!
rows.heard: Yesterday it was just a thin little piece, and today it's whole again.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Кто же её откусил? И кто приклеил обратно?
rows.text: Who took a bite of it? And who glued it back?
rows.heard: who took a bite of it and who glued it back.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Объявляю лунное расследование открытым!
rows.text: The Case of the Bitten Moon is now open!
rows.heard: The case of the bit moon is now open.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Рон, Луну никто не откусывал.
rows.text: Ron, nobody bit the moon.
rows.heard: Ron, nobody bit the moons.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Знаю. Но название у расследования очень вкусное.
rows.text: I know. But the case has a very tasty name.
rows.heard: I know, but the case has a very tasty name.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Я раньше видел Луну круглой.
rows.text: I've seen the moon round before.
rows.heard: I've seen the moon round before.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: А иногда она выглядит как тонкий месяц.
rows.text: And sometimes it looks like a thin crescent.
rows.heard: And sometimes it looks like a thin crescent.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Может, сама Луна меняет форму?
rows.text: Maybe the moon changes its shape?
rows.heard: Maybe the moon changes its shape.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Запомним эту догадку. Утром поищем объяснение.
rows.text: Let's remember that guess. We'll find out in the morning.
rows.heard: Let's remember that guess. We'll find out in the morning.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я готов! Только сначала уберу из списка любителя печенья.
rows.text: I'm ready! But first I'll cross the cookie lover off the list.
rows.heard: I'm ready, but first I'll cross the cookie lover off the list.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Это ты о себе?
rows.text: You mean you?
rows.heard: You mean Jill?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: У меня есть оправдание. До Луны я не дотянусь!
rows.text: I'm innocent. I can't reach the moon!
rows.heard: I'm innocent. I can't reach the moon.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Луна — спутник Земли. Она движется вокруг нашей планеты.
rows.text: The moon is Earth's satellite. It moves around our planet.
rows.heard: The moon is Earth's satellite. It moves around our planet.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: И всё время остаётся целой?
rows.text: And it stays whole all the time?
rows.heard: and it stays whole all the time.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Да. По форме Луна похожа на шар.
rows.text: Yes. The moon is shaped like a ball.
rows.heard: Yes, the moon is shaped like a ball.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Даже когда выглядит как тоненький месяц?
rows.text: Even when it looks like a thin crescent?
rows.heard: Even when it looks like a thin crescent.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Даже тогда.
rows.text: Even then.
rows.heard: Even then.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Целая Луна притворяется кусочком. Запутанное дело!
rows.text: A whole moon pretending to be a piece. What a tricky case!
rows.heard: A whole moon pretending to be a piece. What a tricky case.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Мы смотрим на неё издалека. Важно понять, какую её часть видим.
rows.text: We see it from far away. We need to know which part we see.
rows.heard: We see it from far away. We need to know which part we see.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А что помогает нам её видеть?
rows.text: And what helps us see it?
rows.heard: and what helps us see it.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Солнце освещает Луну.
rows.text: The sun lights up the moon.
rows.heard: The Sun lights up the moon.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: У неё нет своей лампы?
rows.text: It doesn't have its own lamp?
rows.heard: It doesn't have its own lamp.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Нет. Мы видим солнечный свет, отражённый от её поверхности.
rows.text: No. We see sunlight bouncing off its surface.
rows.heard: Now, we see sunlight bouncing off its surface.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вот наш помощник. Круглый и совершенно целый!
rows.text: Here's our helper. Round and totally whole!
rows.heard: Here's our helper, round and totally whole.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Будем представлять Луну?
rows.text: Will it be our moon?
rows.heard: Will it be our moons?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Да. Мяч поможет представить её форму.
rows.text: Yes. The ball helps us picture its shape.
rows.heard: Yes, the ball helps us picture its shape.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Но настоящий месяц на небе выглядит плоским.
rows.text: But the real crescent in the sky looks flat.
rows.heard: but the real crescent in the sky looks flat.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Это его видимая освещённая часть. Сама Луна остаётся похожей на шар.
rows.text: That's just the lit part we can see. The moon itself is still like a ball.
rows.heard: That's just the lit part we can see. The moon itself is still like a ball.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Значит, форма и то, как предмет выглядит, — не всегда одно и то же?
rows.text: So the shape and how a thing looks aren't always the same?
rows.heard: sew the shape and how a thing looks aren't always the same.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Верно.
rows.text: Right.
rows.heard: Right.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Осталось разобраться со светом.
rows.text: Now we just need to figure out the light.
rows.heard: Now we just need to figure out the light.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Только не будем отрезать от мяча кусочки для проверки.
rows.text: Just don't cut pieces off the ball to check.
rows.heard: Just don't cut pieces off the ball to check.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Не будем!
rows.text: We won't!
rows.heard: We won't.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Первый помощник спасён. Продолжаем расследование!
rows.text: Our first helper is saved. On with the investigation!
rows.heard: Our first helper is saved on with the investigation.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Обычно Солнце освещает половину Луны.
rows.text: The sun usually lights up half of the moon.
rows.heard: The sun usually lights up half of the moon.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А другая половина в это время тёмная?
rows.text: And the other half is dark then?
rows.heard: and the other half is dark then.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Да. Луна движется вокруг Земли, и мы видим освещённую половину под разными углами.
rows.text: Yes. The moon moves around the Earth, and we see the lit half from different sides.
rows.heard: Yes, the moon moves around the earth, and we see the lit half from different sides.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Иногда нам видна почти вся светлая половина. Тогда Луна выглядит круглой.
rows.text: Sometimes we see almost the whole bright half. Then the moon looks round.
rows.heard: Sometimes we see almost the whole bright half, then the moon looks round.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А когда видна только узкая часть, получается тонкий месяц.
rows.text: And when we see only a narrow part, we get a thin crescent.
rows.heard: And when we see only a narrow part, we get a thin crescent.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Но остальная Луна никуда не делась!
rows.text: But the rest of the moon is still there!
rows.heard: But the rest of the moon is still there.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Именно. Тёмная часть тоже остаётся на месте.
rows.text: Exactly. The dark part stays right there too.
rows.heard: Exactly, the dark part stays right there too.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Значит, моя догадка была неверной. Форма Луны не меняется.
rows.text: So my guess was wrong. The moon's shape doesn't change.
rows.heard: So my guess was wrong. The moon's shape doesn't change.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Зато твой вопрос помог нам разобраться.
rows.text: But your question helped us figure it out.
rows.heard: But your question helped us figure it out.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А как называется эта смена вида?
rows.text: And what's this change called?
rows.heard: And what's this change called?

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Фазы Луны.
rows.text: Moon phases.
rows.heard: Moon phases.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Запомнил. У Луны фазы, а у печенья — следы моего завтрака.
rows.text: Got it. The moon has phases, and cookies have bite marks from my breakfast.
rows.heard: Got it, the moon has phases, and cookies have bite marks for my breakfast.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Подождите. А тёмная часть — это тень Земли?
rows.text: Wait. Is the dark part the Earth's shadow?
rows.heard: Weight is the dark part of the Earth's shadow.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Нет. Обычные фазы возникают не из-за тени Земли.
rows.text: No. The usual phases don't come from Earth's shadow.
rows.heard: No, the usual phases don't come from Earth's shadow.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Луна движется вокруг нас, и меняется то, сколько её освещённой части нам видно.
rows.text: The moon moves around us, and how much of its lit part we see changes.
rows.heard: the moon moves around us, and how much of its lip part we see changes.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Но тень Земли иногда всё-таки попадает на Луну?
rows.text: But does the Earth's shadow ever fall on the moon?
rows.heard: But does the Earth's shadow ever fall on the moon?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Да. Это называется лунным затмением.
rows.text: Yes. That's called a lunar eclipse.
rows.heard: Yes, that's called a lunar eclipse.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Значит, затмение — отдельная история.
rows.text: So an eclipse is a whole other story.
rows.heard: So an eclipse is a whole other story.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Хорошо, что я спросил. Я почти перепутал.
rows.text: Good thing I asked. I almost mixed it up.
rows.heard: Good thing I asked, I almost mixed it up.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я чуть не перепутал целую Луну с недоеденным печеньем!
rows.text: And I almost mixed up the whole moon with a half-eaten cookie!
rows.heard: And I almost mixed up the whole moon with a half eaten cookie.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Давайте понаблюдаем за ней в разные дни.
rows.text: Let's watch it on different days.
rows.heard: Let's watch it on different days.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: И сравним, как меняется её вид.
rows.text: And compare how it changes.
rows.heard: and compare how it changes.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Настоящая работа для лунного сыщика!
rows.text: A real job for a moon detective!
rows.heard: A real job for a minute detective.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Смотрите, луна!
rows.text: Look, the moon!
rows.heard: Look the moon.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Сегодня запомним, как она выглядит.
rows.text: Let's remember how it looks today.
rows.heard: Let's remember how it looks today.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А через минуту проверим ещё раз?
rows.text: And check again in a minute?
rows.heard: and check again in a minute.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: За минуту заметной смены фазы не будет.
rows.text: In one minute, the phase won't change.
rows.heard: In one minute, the phase won't change.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Сравнивать лучше наблюдения за разные дни.
rows.text: It's better to compare different days.
rows.heard: It's better to compare different days.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Значит, всю ночь дежурить не нужно?
rows.text: So we don't have to stay up all night?
rows.heard: so we don't have to stay up all night.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Не нужно. Посмотрим и пойдём отдыхать.
rows.text: No. We'll look and then go rest.
rows.heard: No, we'll look and then go rest.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Завтра я помогу сделать запись.
rows.text: Tomorrow I'll help write it down.
rows.heard: Tomorrow, I'll help write it down.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я прослежу, чтобы никто не нарисовал Луне уши.
rows.text: And I'll make sure nobody draws ears on the moon.
rows.heard: And I'll make sure nobody draws ears on the moon.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Даже щенячьи?
rows.text: Even puppy ears?
rows.heard: Even puppy ears.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Даже самые красивые.
rows.text: Even the cutest ones.
rows.heard: Even the cutest ones.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Прошла неделя. Друзья сравнили свои наблюдения за Луной.
rows.text: A week went by. The friends compared their notes about the moon.
rows.heard: A week went by. The friends compared their notes about the moon.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: В ясные вечера мы видели, как её освещённая часть постепенно менялась.
rows.text: On clear evenings, we saw the lit part change little by little.
rows.heard: On clear evenings, we saw the lip part change little by little.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А однажды я вообще не нашёл Луну.
rows.text: And once I couldn't find the moon at all.
rows.heard: and once I couldn't find the moon at all.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Но ты заметил облака.
rows.text: But you spotted the clouds.
rows.heard: But you spotted the clouds.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Да. В тот вечер они закрыли небо.
rows.text: Yes. That evening they covered the sky.
rows.heard: Yes, that evening they covered the sky.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Облака могут скрыть Луну. Это не смена её фазы.
rows.text: Clouds can hide the moon. That's not a change of phase.
rows.heard: Clouds can hide the moon. That's not a change of phase.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Поэтому в наблюдениях важно отмечать и погоду.
rows.text: That's why we should write down the weather too.
rows.heard: That's why we should write down the weather too.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Запишу: в облачный вечер сравнить вид Луны не получилось.
rows.text: I'll write: on the cloudy evening, we couldn't compare the moon.
rows.heard: I'll write, on the cloudy evening, we couldn't compare the moon.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Правильно. Если чего-то не увидел, придумывать не надо.
rows.text: Right. If you didn't see something, don't make it up.
rows.heard: Right, if you didn't see something, don't make it up.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Главный сыщик стал очень внимательным.
rows.text: The chief detective got very careful.
rows.heard: The chief detective got very careful.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Пришлось. Подозреваемых нет, а вопросов много!
rows.text: I had to. No suspects, but lots of questions!
rows.heard: I had too, no suspects but lots of questions.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Последний вопрос расследования. Почему Луна выглядит по-разному?
rows.text: The last question of the case. Why does the moon look different?
rows.heard: The last question of the case, why does the moon look different?

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Потому что с Земли нам видна разная часть её освещённой половины.
rows.text: Because from Earth we see different parts of its lit half.
rows.heard: Because from Earth, we see different parts of its lid half.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А сама Луна остаётся целой!
rows.text: And the moon itself stays whole!
rows.heard: And the moon itself stays whole.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Дело раскрыто.
rows.text: Case closed.
rows.heard: Case closed.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Зато сейчас случится настоящее исчезновение.
rows.text: But now a real disappearance is about to happen.
rows.heard: But now a real disappearance is about to happen.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Рон съел печенье.
rows.text: Ron ate the cookie.
rows.heard: Ron ate the cookie.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Здесь даже расследовать нечего.
rows.text: Nothing to investigate here.
rows.heard: Nothing to investigate here.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Слишком много свидетелей!
rows.text: Too many witnesses!
rows.heard: Too many witnesses.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: После завтрака проверим место, где посадили жёлудь?
rows.text: After breakfast, shall we check where we planted the acorn?
rows.heard: After breakfast, shall we check where we planted the acorn?

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Да. И возьмём дневник.
rows.text: Yes. And let's take the diary.
rows.heard: Yes, and let's take the diary.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Пошёл дождь.
rows.text: It's raining.
rows.heard: It's raining.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Ой! Кепка к прогулке не готова!
rows.text: Oh! My cap isn't ready for a walk!
rows.heard: Oh, my cap isn't ready for a walk.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Подождём здесь.
rows.text: Let's wait here.
rows.heard: Let's wait here.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А земля возле жёлудя получит воду.
rows.text: And the soil by the acorn will get water.
rows.heard: and the soil by the acorn will get water.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Через некоторое время дождь закончился.
rows.text: After a while, the rain stopped.
rows.heard: After a while, the rain stopped.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Дождь кончился.
rows.text: The rain is over.
rows.heard: The rain is over.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вспомнил ещё одну загадку.
rows.text: I've got one more mystery.
rows.heard: I've got one more mystery.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Какую?
rows.text: Which one?
rows.heard: Which one?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: После дождя бывают лужи. А потом их нет. Куда уходит вода?
rows.text: After rain there are puddles. Then they're gone. Where does the water go?
rows.heard: After rain there are puddles, then they're gone, where does the water go?

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Может, впитывается в землю?
rows.text: Maybe it soaks into the ground?
rows.heard: Maybe it soaks into the ground.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А если лужа на асфальте?
rows.text: And if the puddle is on asphalt?
rows.heard: and if the puddle is on asphalt.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Это и выясним в следующий раз.
rows.text: We'll find out next time.
rows.heard: We'll find out next time.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Список подозреваемых пока составлять не буду.
rows.text: I won't make a list of suspects yet.
rows.heard: I won't make a list of suspects yet.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Почему?
rows.text: Why?
rows.heard: Why?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Сначала проверю. Вдруг лужи тоже никто не пил!
rows.text: First I'll check. Maybe nobody drank the puddles either!
rows.heard: First I'll check. Maybe nobody drank the puddles either.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понравился мультик? Попроси маму или папу подписаться на канал. До встречи в новой серии!
rows.text: Did you like the cartoon? Ask your mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
rows.heard: Did you like the cartoon? Ask your mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
